card.name: End of first drug name in a pair
card.fires_on: The last piece of the first item in a list of two or three named drugs or conditions, just before 'or' or 'and' and the next item. Seen in interaction warnings and in lists like SJS, TEN, or DRESS.

modes.label: Drug name before 'or'

modes.description: Final piece of an abbreviation such as SJS, before the next listed condition.

modes.label: Brand name before slash or 'and'
modes.description: End of a brand name followed by a second brand or product name.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward starting a second, parallel item, such as 'second' or 'other', after the first.
card.plain: It fires at the end of the first drug or condition name when a second one is about to be named.
